d:
Rajasthan's local body election results have dealt a setback to the BJP, with several high-profile leaders facing defeats in their own constituencies. Urban Development Minister Jhabar Singh Kharra's wife and both sons lost their elections in Sikar. In Jaipur's Jhotwara, BJP managed to win just one of 15 Panchayat Samiti seats in Minister Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore's constituency. Meanwhile, Congress has taken a significant lead in Zila Parishad results. What do these results reveal about Rajasthan's political landscape? Here's a detailed breakdown.
